title: I Followed the Glassblowing Glory-Hole Booking Into the Slot They Took

parts.text: I booked glory-hole 2 from 2:00 to 4:00 and at 2:04 maker Soren had a gather in my heat. The whiteboard said: BOOK THE HOLE. TWO-HOUR BLOCKS. NO WALK-UPS MID-SLOT. I was thirty-three, student, holding a paid block. Soren did not step off. "Heat is a walk-up of the shop." I photographed the board, the receipt, and his pipe in my hole. Then I logged a mid-slot take. At 2:12 the studio manager asked why Soren's pipe was on my block. I asked once, then I documented twice. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The studio manager can see Soren's pipe in glory-hole 2 on my paid two-hour block.

social.video_title: He gathered in my booked heat — Part 1/2
social.description: Glass studio, a whiteboard block, and a pipe in my hole. I logged the take. Would you have waited with the receipt?

parts.text: Soren called it a save until the manager asked for the log. I printed the take, the photo, and the board. He stepped off. Soren booked his own heat and told students saves were always about optics. Optics is a word makers use when a pipe exists. Booking now has a second line: HEAT IS NOT A WALK-UP. I keep my two hours. Soren waits. The shop finally looks like a schedule, not a steal. The room sounds like a room again, not a title. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.

social.video_title: Heat is not a walk-up — Part 2/2
social.description: Take log, open hole, and a second line. Was a save ever my block?
